name: core-imports
command:
import importlib, importlib.metadata as md, importlib.util, json, sys
import numpy as np
modules={name:importlib.import_module("ideal_poly_volume_toolkit"+("."+name if name else "")) for name in ["", "geometry", "optimization", "variational", "rivin_delaunay", "rivin_holonomy", "geometric_realization"]}
paths={name:module.__file__ for name,module in modules.items()}
assert all("polyhedra-release-core-v2-20261102/lib/python3.12/site-packages/" in path for path in paths.values()),paths
optional=["torch","gymnasium","gradio","pynauty","hypothesis","matplotlib","networkx","plotly","PIL"]
absent={name:importlib.util.find_spec(name) is None for name in optional}
assert all(absent.values()),absent
vertices=np.array([0.0j,1.0+0.0j,np.exp(1j*np.pi/3)],dtype=np.complex128)
volume=modules["geometry"].ideal_poly_volume_via_delaunay(vertices,mode="bloch_wigner")
assert abs(volume-1.0149416064096537)<2e-15,volume
assert modules["optimization"].negative_volume_objective([np.pi/3,np.pi/2],4)<0
assert "torch" not in sys.modules
print(json.dumps({"python":sys.version,"prefix":sys.prefix,"module_paths":paths,"optional_modules_absent":absent,"tetrahedron_direct_volume":volume,"distributions":{d.metadata["Name"]:d.version for d in md.distributions()}},indent=2))
